author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! Talks of the AI bubble are something I've had on this channel recently and it's been on all our minds as this tech keeps reigning its way into our lives. The biggest and bullish companies are now pointing out how inefficient and costly it is to actually run these models and unless they can find a way to make this process cheaper, the demand for it will start drying up. How did we get here? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: They Just Admitted The AI Bubble Is Popping...
